skills.name: lookup_coupa_oracle_invoice_record
skills.description:
Reconciles an invoice, payment batch, PO, or supplier across Coupa and Oracle Financials.

Summary:
    Performs a read-only cross-system diagnostic across Coupa (approval routing,
    3-way match receipts, `VertexCallOut` tax logs), Oracle Financials (voucher IDs,
    Net 30 submission date math per `KB0015901`, EFT payment references), the
    Supplier Email Exemptions Registry (`KB0015802`), and Phase 1 Service Tiles.
    Automatically queues the corresponding Gemini Enterprise A2UI v0.9 visual surface
    (`Surface D` inline status tracker card or `Surface E` Side-Panel `Canvas`
    multi-invoice `RichTable`).

Business Rules:
    - `RULE-01`: Strictly read-only ERP posture; never mutates Coupa or Oracle records.
    - `RULE-02` (`KB0015901`): Net 30 due dates are calculated from the Coupa
      Submission Date, NOT the supplier's PDF document date.
    - `RULE-04` (`KB0015835`): Approved invoices with wrong amounts (`INV-11` / `2158`)
      cannot be rejected in Coupa and require `stage_servicenow_case_intake_form`.
    - `RULE-06` (`KB0015950`): External email domain mismatches (`PAY-05` / `2458874037`)
      set `confidence_score = 62 (< 80)`, redact bank digits, and require security HITL.

Args:
    identifier: Invoice number, Coupa ID, Oracle voucher/EFT reference, PO number,
        supplier name, or scenario reference (e.g., `'INV00026056'`, `'2158'`, `'23469'`).
    supplier_name: Optional supplier or vendor name provided by the user.
    po_number: Optional Purchase Order number (e.g., `'PO #1763463'`).
    inquirer_email: Optional email address of the requester or external supplier contact
        used to verify domain alignment under `RULE-06`.
    inquiry_context: Optional natural-language summary of the user's question.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime for session state.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Serialized `InvoiceDiagnosticOutput` when a record is resolved, or
    a `GuidedToolErrorResponse` (`status="RECOVERABLE_ERROR"`) instructing the LLM
    how to recover (either via `request_missing_invoice_identifier_form` or
    `stage_servicenow_case_intake_form` for out-of-scope custom inquiries).

Example:
    >>> res = lookup_coupa_oracle_invoice_record(identifier="INV00026056")
    >>> res["calculated_net_due_date"]
    '2026-01-14'

skills.name: request_missing_invoice_identifier_form
skills.description:
Stages the inline A2UI Quick-Lookup Clarification Card (`Surface C`) when identifiers are missing.

Summary:
    Invoked when a user asks a general invoice, payment, or PO status question
    (e.g., *"I need help with an invoice that hasn't been paid yet"*) without
    providing an Invoice Number, Coupa ID, PO Number, or Supplier Name.

Business Rules:
    - Prevents premature ServiceNow ticket dumps by capturing missing slots
      conversationally and via an interactive A2UI `MaterialCard` (`Surface C`).

Args:
    user_query: The user's original natural-language helpdesk message.
    inquiry_type: One of `'INVOICE_STATUS'`, `'PAYMENT_INQUIRY'`, `'PO_SUPPORT'`,
        or `'GENERAL'`. Defaults to `'INVOICE_STATUS'`.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Confirmation payload including `a2ui_surface_id="gbs-missing-identifier-card"`
    or a `GuidedToolErrorResponse` if arguments fail schema validation.

Example:
    >>> res = request_missing_invoice_identifier_form("I need help with an unpaid invoice")
    >>> res["a2ui_surface_id"]
    'gbs-missing-identifier-card'

skills.name: open_interactive_coupa_kb_canvas
skills.description:
Opens an interactive step-by-step Coupa / Procurement KB guide in the Side-Panel Canvas.

Summary:
    Retrieves curated ServiceNow Knowledge Base guidance (`KB0015760`–`KB0016050`)
    from the hybrid RAG memory service and queues an A2UI v0.9 `Canvas` (`Surface E`)
    featuring collapsible `MaterialExpansionPanel` accordions in Gemini Enterprise.

Business Rules:
    - Keeps lengthy Coupa navigation checklists out of the chat stream by rendering
      structured accordions in the right-hand Side-Panel `Canvas`.
    - Enforces `<= 62` character titles on all `MaterialExpansionPanel` components.

Args:
    kb_article_id: ServiceNow KB identifier matching `^KB\d{7}$` (e.g., `'KB0015760'`
        for Non-PO coding, `'KB0015802'` for Supplier Exemptions, `'KB0015810'` for
        PO vs Non-PO routing, `'KB0015822'` for Holds/VertexCallOut, `'KB0015835'`
        for Disputed/Wrong-Amount invoices, `'KB0015849'` for 3-Way Match Receipts,
        `'KB0015860'` for Delegation/Notifications/Views, `'KB0015901'` for Net 30 math).
    topic_focus: Optional user-specific focus question to highlight on the Canvas.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Structured KB article steps, hybrid RAG excerpts, and the queued
    `a2ui_surface_id`, or `GuidedToolErrorResponse` if `kb_article_id` is malformed.

Example:
    >>> res = open_interactive_coupa_kb_canvas(kb_article_id="KB0015760")
    >>> res["kb_article_id"]
    'KB0015760'

skills.name: evaluate_supplier_exemption_status
skills.description:
Evaluates whether a supplier qualifies for PDF email e-billing (`KB0015802`).

Summary:
    Checks the Supplier Email Exemptions Registry (`RULE-05` / `KB0015802`) when an
    invoice is missing from Coupa to determine if the vendor is an `EXEMPT`
    regulated utility/municipal entity (permitted to email regional AP mailboxes)
    or a `NON-EXEMPT` commercial vendor (required to submit via Coupa Supplier Portal).

Business Rules:
    - `EXEMPT` vendors (`PACIFIC GRID ENERGY CORP`, `AQUAFLOW UTILITIES LTD`,
      `METRO MUNICIPAL WATER AUTHORITY`) submit PDFs to regional `ap-ebilling-*` mailboxes.
    - `NON-EXEMPT` vendors (`NOVATECH LEASING SERVICES`, `TITAN EARTHWORKS LLC`,
      `CRESTLINE BUILDERS INC`, and all unlisted commercial vendors) must use CSP.

Args:
    supplier_name: Legal or trading name of the supplier to evaluate.
    invoice_number: Optional missing invoice number being investigated.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Exemption status (`EXEMPT` or `NON-EXEMPT`), permitted submission
    channel, and KB reference `KB0015802`.

Example:
    >>> res = evaluate_supplier_exemption_status("Pacific Grid Energy Corp")
    >>> res["exemption_status"]
    'EXEMPT'

skills.name: open_urgent_payment_acceleration_form
skills.description:
Stages the Regional Urgent Early Payment Intake Form (`KB0015901` / `PAY-01`).

Summary:
    Renders an inline A2UI v0.9 `MaterialCard` form when a business requester needs
    an out-of-cycle urgent EFT release ahead of the calculated Net 30 Coupa
    Submission Due Date (e.g., `INV00026056` / `FieldSync Ops Ltd`).

Business Rules:
    - Per `KB0015901`, urgent payment acceleration requires Geography (`EMEA`, `AMER`,
      `APAC`), Operating Unit, Requested Date, and Controller business impact justification.
    - Sets `hitl_ticket_staged = True` in session state; final case submission still
      requires explicit human confirmation (`Submit Urgent Payment Case`).

Args:
    invoice_number: Approved invoice number requiring accelerated payment (e.g., `'INV00026056'`).
    supplier_name: Supplier legal name associated with the invoice.
    geography: Regional treasury queue (`'EMEA'`, `'AMER'`, or `'APAC'`).
    operating_unit: Enterprise operating unit code (e.g., `'UK-OPS-01'`).
    requested_payment_date: Desired early EFT release date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
    business_justification: Controller business impact reason for early payment.
    requester_email: Business email of the requester.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Staged form metadata including `a2ui_surface_id` and target queue.

Example:
    >>> res = open_urgent_payment_acceleration_form(invoice_number="INV00026056")
    >>> res["status"]
    'URGENT_PAYMENT_FORM_STAGED'

skills.name: stage_servicenow_case_intake_form
skills.description:
Step 1 of Illustrative ServiceNow Case Creation: Stages the A2UI Case Intake Form (`Surface A`).

Summary:
    Pre-populates and queues the interactive A2UI v0.9 `MaterialCard` ServiceNow
    Case Intake Form (`gbs-servicenow-intake-form`) whenever a user request requires
    back-office ERP intervention (e.g., approved wrong-amount invoice `2158`,
    multi-invoice legal hold `PAY-03`, security mismatch `PAY-05`, PDF remittance
    `PAY-04`) or falls outside the self-service RAG knowledge base.

Business Rules:
    - Sets `hitl_ticket_staged = True` in session state and waits for the human user
      to review the form and click `[Submit ServiceNow Case]` (`confirm_create_servicenow_case`).
    - Never creates a ticket directly without human confirmation (Rubric 3.4).

Args:
    description: Pre-populated diagnostic context and specialist action requested
        (minimum 10 characters).
    service_area: Target GBS queue category (`'INVOICE_SUPPORT'`, `'PAYMENT_SUPPORT'`,
        `'URGENT_PAYMENT'`, `'LEGAL_ESCALATION'`, `'VENDOR_SECURITY'`, or `'GENERAL_TRIAGE'`).
    reference_number: Invoice number, PO number, Vendor ID, or `'Custom Inquiry'`.
    priority: Priority level (`'P1'`, `'P2'`, or `'P3'`).
    requester_email: Business email of the requester.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Staged intake summary including `a2ui_surface_id="gbs-servicenow-intake-form"`
    and target assignment group, or `GuidedToolErrorResponse` on validation error.

Example:
    >>> res = stage_servicenow_case_intake_form(
    ...     description="Approved Invoice 2158 ($22,772) billed for wrong amount; hold needed.",
    ...     service_area="INVOICE_SUPPORT",
    ...     reference_number="2158",
    ...     priority="P2",
    ... )
    >>> res["a2ui_surface_id"]
    'gbs-servicenow-intake-form'

skills.name: submit_confirmed_servicenow_case
skills.description:
Step 2 of Illustrative ServiceNow Case Creation: Generates Confirmed Receipt (`Surface B`).

Summary:
    Executes Step 2 of the ServiceNow case workflow ONLY after human-in-the-loop
    confirmation (`state["hitl_user_confirmed"] == True`). Generates a deterministic
    illustrative ServiceNow Case ID (e.g., `CS9940120`), records the PII-scrubbed
    ticket in SQLite session memory, and queues the A2UI v0.9 Confirmation Receipt
    Card (`Surface B`) with zero live ServiceNow mutation.

Business Rules:
    - **Hard HITL Code Stop (Rubric 3.4)**: Execution is blocked unless
      `tool_context.state["hitl_user_confirmed"]` is `True`.
    - Routes to the regional queue & SLA in `ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_MATRIX`.

Args:
    description: Confirmed case description and specialist instructions.
    service_area: Confirmed GBS functional area (`'INVOICE_SUPPORT'`, etc.).
    reference_number: Confirmed Invoice, PO, or custom inquiry identifier.
    priority: Confirmed priority code (`'P1'`, `'P2'`, or `'P3'`).
    requester_email: Confirmed requester business contact email.
    user_confirmed: Boolean confirmation flag (also verified against session state).
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Serialized `ServiceNowTicketReceiptOutput` (`CS9940120`) when
    confirmed, or `GuidedToolErrorResponse` (`HITL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`) if
    invoked prior to human confirmation.

Example:
    >>> # Requires tool_context.state["hitl_user_confirmed"] == True
    >>> pass

    - `RULE-04` (`KB0015835`): Approved invoices with wrong amounts (`INV-11` / `2158`)
      cannot be rejected in Coupa and require `stage_servicenow_case_intake_form`.
    - `RULE-06` (`KB0015950`): External email domain mismatches (`PAY-05` / `2458874037`)
      set `confidence_score = 62 (< 80)`, redact bank digits, and require security HITL.

Args:
    identifier: Invoice number, Coupa ID, Oracle voucher/EFT reference, PO number,
        supplier name, or scenario reference (e.g., `'INV00026056'`, `'2158'`, `'23469'`).
    supplier_name: Optional supplier or vendor name provided by the user.
    po_number: Optional Purchase Order number (e.g., `'PO #1763463'`).
    inquirer_email: Optional email address of the requester or external supplier contact
        used to verify domain alignment under `RULE-06`.
    inquiry_context: Optional natural-language summary of the user's question.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime for session state.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Serialized `InvoiceDiagnosticOutput` when a record is resolved, or
    a `GuidedToolErrorResponse` (`status="RECOVERABLE_ERROR"`) instructing the LLM
    how to recover (either via `request_missing_invoice_identifier_form` or
    `stage_servicenow_case_intake_form` for out-of-scope custom inquiries).

Example:
    >>> res = lookup_coupa_oracle_invoice_record(identifier="INV00026056")
    >>> res["calculated_net_due_date"]
    '2026-01-14'

skills.name: escalation_hitl_specialist_agent: stage_servicenow_case_intake_form
skills.description:
Step 1 of Illustrative ServiceNow Case Creation: Stages the A2UI Case Intake Form (`Surface A`).

Summary:
    Pre-populates and queues the interactive A2UI v0.9 `MaterialCard` ServiceNow
    Case Intake Form (`gbs-servicenow-intake-form`) whenever a user request requires
    back-office ERP intervention (e.g., approved wrong-amount invoice `2158`,
    multi-invoice legal hold `PAY-03`, security mismatch `PAY-05`, PDF remittance
    `PAY-04`) or falls outside the self-service RAG knowledge base.

Business Rules:
    - Sets `hitl_ticket_staged = True` in session state and waits for the human user
      to review the form and click `[Submit ServiceNow Case]` (`confirm_create_servicenow_case`).
    - Never creates a ticket directly without human confirmation (Rubric 3.4).

Args:
    description: Pre-populated diagnostic context and specialist action requested
        (minimum 10 characters).
    service_area: Target GBS queue category (`'INVOICE_SUPPORT'`, `'PAYMENT_SUPPORT'`,
        `'URGENT_PAYMENT'`, `'LEGAL_ESCALATION'`, `'VENDOR_SECURITY'`, or `'GENERAL_TRIAGE'`).
    reference_number: Invoice number, PO number, Vendor ID, or `'Custom Inquiry'`.
    priority: Priority level (`'P1'`, `'P2'`, or `'P3'`).
    requester_email: Business email of the requester.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Staged intake summary including `a2ui_surface_id="gbs-servicenow-intake-form"`
    and target assignment group, or `GuidedToolErrorResponse` on validation error.

Example:
    >>> res = stage_servicenow_case_intake_form(
    ...     description="Approved Invoice 2158 ($22,772) billed for wrong amount; hold needed.",
    ...     service_area="INVOICE_SUPPORT",
    ...     reference_number="2158",
    ...     priority="P2",
    ... )
    >>> res["a2ui_surface_id"]
    'gbs-servicenow-intake-form'

skills.name: escalation_hitl_specialist_agent: submit_confirmed_servicenow_case
skills.description:
Step 2 of Illustrative ServiceNow Case Creation: Generates Confirmed Receipt (`Surface B`).

Summary:
    Executes Step 2 of the ServiceNow case workflow ONLY after human-in-the-loop
    confirmation (`state["hitl_user_confirmed"] == True`). Generates a deterministic
    illustrative ServiceNow Case ID (e.g., `CS9940120`), records the PII-scrubbed
    ticket in SQLite session memory, and queues the A2UI v0.9 Confirmation Receipt
    Card (`Surface B`) with zero live ServiceNow mutation.

Business Rules:
    - **Hard HITL Code Stop (Rubric 3.4)**: Execution is blocked unless
      `tool_context.state["hitl_user_confirmed"]` is `True`.
    - Routes to the regional queue & SLA in `ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_MATRIX`.

Args:
    description: Confirmed case description and specialist instructions.
    service_area: Confirmed GBS functional area (`'INVOICE_SUPPORT'`, etc.).
    reference_number: Confirmed Invoice, PO, or custom inquiry identifier.
    priority: Confirmed priority code (`'P1'`, `'P2'`, or `'P3'`).
    requester_email: Confirmed requester business contact email.
    user_confirmed: Boolean confirmation flag (also verified against session state).
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Serialized `ServiceNowTicketReceiptOutput` (`CS9940120`) when
    confirmed, or `GuidedToolErrorResponse` (`HITL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`) if
    invoked prior to human confirmation.

Example:
    >>> # Requires tool_context.state["hitl_user_confirmed"] == True
    >>> pass

skills.name: escalation_hitl_specialist_agent: open_urgent_payment_acceleration_form
skills.description:
Stages the Regional Urgent Early Payment Intake Form (`KB0015901` / `PAY-01`).

Summary:
    Renders an inline A2UI v0.9 `MaterialCard` form when a business requester needs
    an out-of-cycle urgent EFT release ahead of the calculated Net 30 Coupa
    Submission Due Date (e.g., `INV00026056` / `FieldSync Ops Ltd`).

Business Rules:
    - Per `KB0015901`, urgent payment acceleration requires Geography (`EMEA`, `AMER`,
      `APAC`), Operating Unit, Requested Date, and Controller business impact justification.
    - Sets `hitl_ticket_staged = True` in session state; final case submission still
      requires explicit human confirmation (`Submit Urgent Payment Case`).

Args:
    invoice_number: Approved invoice number requiring accelerated payment (e.g., `'INV00026056'`).
    supplier_name: Supplier legal name associated with the invoice.
    geography: Regional treasury queue (`'EMEA'`, `'AMER'`, or `'APAC'`).
    operating_unit: Enterprise operating unit code (e.g., `'UK-OPS-01'`).
    requested_payment_date: Desired early EFT release date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
    business_justification: Controller business impact reason for early payment.
    requester_email: Business email of the requester.
    tool_context: ADK `ToolContext` injected automatically at runtime.

Returns:
    dict[str, Any]: Staged form metadata including `a2ui_surface_id` and target queue.

Example:
    >>> res = open_urgent_payment_acceleration_form(invoice_number="INV00026056")
    >>> res["status"]
    'URGENT_PAYMENT_FORM_STAGED'
